migrationCompatibility.notes: One migration widens the workflow_runs.stop_reason CHECK constraint to admit concluded_without_changes and required_steps_unfulfilled. Expand-only: no column is narrowed, dropped or retyped, and stop_reason is already String(32) so both values (25 and 26 chars) fit without widening the column. Stable code never emits the new values, so a stable process running against the migrated schema is unaffected and a code-only rollback is safe. The asymmetry to state plainly, exactly as migration 042 (#1359) did: DOWNGRADE runs after the new code has been live, so rows may already carry the new values and create_check_constraint will fail loudly rather than silently discard them — that is correct behaviour, not a defect. Choose the revision id against the live alembic head; the W7 wave carries a parallel chain and #1359 had to take 042 rather than 044 to avoid forking it.

rollbackAssertion.postCutoverFailureBehavior: redeploy the prior release; the widened CHECK constraint stays in place and is harmless to stable code, which never emits the new stop reasons. Do not downgrade the migration to roll back code.

acceptanceCommands: PYTHONPATH=$PWD/backend/src python -m pytest tests/unit -k 'runner or termination or status_mapping' -q
doNotInfer: Do not implement 'reject final_response when required steps are incomplete' — ADR-088 records that as a rejected alternative because it destroys the legitimate no-write outcome ADR-073 d.2 protects.
Do not treat this as a prompt fix. Prompt v4 is a later round and is explicitly an optimisation, not the mechanism.
Do not let the forced retry fire on a run whose required steps are already complete, and do not allow more than one forced re-invocation per run.
Do not give conclude_without_changes any side effect — a terminal tool that can write is a path around the CONFIRM gate.
Do not edit models.py's CHECK constraint without an accompanying alembic migration; the unit DB is sqlite built from models.py and structurally cannot catch the omission.
Do not write to any production shop. Sandbox only, and never Fujiwa (2b1da87b-d0a8-46a6-b3c6-2132be0b5f4f).
